name: tineghir-website
description: Static tourism website for Tineghir, Morocco

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:build-debug: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build-debug-win: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:build-release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:build-release-win: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
